# Agent harness (Google)

Google says agent harness in the industry's sense of an [agent harness][industry.agent-harness]: "a shared, highly optimized agent harness co-trained with Gemini models" ([Antigravity overview][g2]).

## Examples

- The Antigravity harness, shared by every Antigravity surface, and the Antigravity SDK ([Antigravity overview][g2]).
- The Agent Development Kit (ADK) ([ADK sessions][g5]).
